credit_rule.section_key: sha256 of the sectionize() body of SKILL.md at the measured revision; matched against entry['sha256'] only (measure.py:209-255, 602-612)
gates_in_order: findings/shape: verdict in the six strings, not in {gap-blocking, wrong-expectation, not-executed}, blocking_gaps==0, wrong_expectations==0 as JSON ints (:459)
class gate: instruction -> verdict in {executed-ok, gap-minor} and commands_executed_count>=1; record -> verdict in {verified-record, gap-minor} (:477)
commands gate: commands_executed_count > 0 for every class (:513)

input gate: inputs minus IGNORED_INPUTS non-empty; every key canonical lane-relative; git ls-tree REV -- p names one 100644/100755 entry; sha256(git cat-file blob REV:p) equals the recorded digest (:330-353)
trace gate: >=1 committed trace blob at REV, schema tameshi-trace-inputs-v1, trace inputs a subset of entry inputs with equal digests, no unbound live-lane external read (:373-457)
aggregation: covered iff >=1 entry credits AND no veto-eligible entry whose inputs still verify at REV (:612-655)
not_inputs_to_credit: read_rev (never read by any credit path; probe: read_rev='nonsense' still credits)
the reader report (*.json under .ufo/waves/**) - never opened by the credit rule; only the binder reads it
entry['reports'] and entry['seats'] - written by the binder, validated by nothing
entry['skill_sha256'], entry['start'], entry['end'] - matching is by section sha256 alone

binder.frozen_argv_note: exactly four positional arguments, no flags (binder.py:44); the frozen script hard-codes the round-54 heading files (:50-52), round-54 wave dirs (:48) and the round-54 resolutions file (:53), so it cannot re-key round 55 unmodified
round55_argv: <json list file of exact heading strings>
binder.outdir_constraint: must be inside LANE: the trace path is os.path.relpath(OUT, LANE)+'/traces/section-NN.json' (:167); a '..' component fails canonical_lane_path and the section reads trace-missing:<path> (measured)
binder.writes: <LANE>/.ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/ledger.json (working tree, binder.py:197) plus OUT/traces/*.json and OUT/refresh-receipts.json - the L1 must commit all of them

drop.LOG.md: rewritten every round after the bind; keeping it makes the fresh entry stale at the next record commit (round-53 failure mode). Counterfactual: post-pin SCORECARD.md edit without DROP -> entry_reason='input-drift:SCORECARD.md', section uncovered
drop.SKILL.md: the page being sectioned; its per-section sha is the ledger key and the credit rule already ignores it (IGNORED_INPUTS)
drop..ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/ledger.j: the binder's own output; also in IGNORED_INPUTS

drops_also: any input path whose blob is absent at PIN (blob_at(pin,p) is None) - appended to the receipt's dropped list
nothing else: inputs are re-hashed from the PIN blob, never carried from the prior entry's recorded digest
binder.reader_sibling_requirement: <same stem>.md must exist next to the .json (existence only; zero bytes accepted)
binder.empty_findings: accepted: len(findings)=0 <= allowed -> REKEY, minor_gaps=0. A reader with NO findings key is also accepted (d.get('findings') or []). A reader with more findings than allowed with no --resolutions file (allowed=0) is refused with 'reader-has-findings:N>0'

field_rules.heading: must equal the sectionizer's heading string byte for byte (em dashes included)
field_rules.cand: compared to `git rev-parse --verify <C0>^{commit}` (binder.py:78,118): a 12-hex prefix never matches, and the commit must exist in the LANE object store
field_rules.section_sha256: the section BODY sha from the frozen round-18 sectionizer extracted at C0 - not the sha of SKILL.md
field_rules.findings: empty list (or omit); anything non-empty needs an adjudicated --resolutions count

lane_worktree_at_audit_time.note: SKILL.md changed under this seat while it worked (a157f37d -> e0ce89f7); every value must be re-derived at the landed commit

unusable_dry_bind_reader.why_unusable: the binder resolves C0 with git -C LANE rev-parse and compares the reader's cand to that string; a clone-only commit can never be the bind's C0, and the section sha predates the current SKILL.md bytes

coldread_after_rekey_standing_rules_only.note: post-PIN edit of a pinned input costs credit

coldread_after_rekey_all_18_then_six_pin.note: PIN must be the last commit touching any pinned input

measured.no_harm_floor_requirement: NOHARM coldread-floor ok iff score>=8 and credited>=64; deciding-run.sh exits non-zero on any RED line

heading_drift_causes.note: counts are sections whose pinned input union contains the path; the union over these six is exactly the 18 headings above

binder_behaviours_measured.reader_heading_not_in_headings_file: SKIP no-clean-reader (the heading is never looked up)
binder_behaviours_measured.dirty_reader_sorts_before_clean: SKIP reader-has-findings (the loop breaks at the first cand+sha match)

findings.what: the re-key obligation is 18 headings, not 1: only re-keying `## Standing rules` leaves 47/64 against a >=64 no-harm monitor, so deciding-run.sh exits non-zero
the existing dry-bind reader is unusable: cand/pin commits exist in no lane object and its section sha predates the current SKILL.md bytes
a dirty reader that sorts before a clean one blocks the heading (binder.py:121-124 break)
ORDERING: the six files the round edits are pinned inputs of 18 sections and are not in DROP, so corpus/QUALITY.md and corpus/SOURCES.md must be landed at or before PIN
an omitted findings key is accepted as clean; the binder cannot distinguish it from a real clean read
the reader's skill_sha256 is never checked
'newest prior entry' is max() on the read_rev string, so it picked the round-17 entry over the round-54 one for `## Standing rules`
a failing prior verdict is rewritten to executed-ok/verified-record, and blocking/wrong counts are hard-coded 0: the binder can never emit a failing entry
commands_executed_count is synthesized as 1+len(inputs) = 2498, not a command count
read_rev, reports, seats, external_inputs, start, end, skill_sha256 are validated by no counter - the enforced rev binding is the section sha plus the input digests
the bound entry is verdict=gap-minor with minor_gaps=0
binder docstring says SKILL.md's ignored status is left to the credit algorithm while DROP also drops SKILL.md

blob_at() uses git show, not git cat-file blob, so a directory input would be hashed from a tree listing and later rejected as input-not-blob (none of the 2497 carried inputs is a non-blob at the frozen base)

reported not fixed: .ufo/evidence/round-55/no-harm.sh:5-7 says the 64/64 cold-read floor is the obligation for 'the one SKILL.md section its edit drifts', while 18 sections lose credit (17 from the round's record/tool edits)
